d:
This is the first story with some depth to it that I tried translating. I hope I did an acceptable job with it. I really like the psychological angle this has, with repressed memories and a false reality. Should do more of these. Let me know if you know of any good pieces with similar themes. Psychology, trauma, its consequences, all that good stuff.
